items.criterion: Two simultaneous applications with one email leave exactly one account and one profile.
items.judgment: Fire two applications with one email at one barrier and count account and profile rows.

items.criterion: A profile that is not live answers not-found at every public address and is absent from every list and the sitemap.
items.judgment: Read ada-moreau as a visitor, a creator and a curator, then scan the lists and the sitemap.

items.criterion: An owner edit to a live profile stays pending while the public keeps the live copy.
items.judgment: Save a new statement on a live profile and compare the public read with the owner's pending copy.

items.criterion: A reviewed division change moves the profile from the old division roster to the new one.
items.judgment: Send a division change for review, publish as the curator and read both division rosters.

items.criterion: A creator is refused every studio route with the protected profile unchanged.
items.judgment: Call publish, send back, take down, move and reorder with a creator token and read the row.

items.criterion: One creator can neither read nor change another creator's profile.
items.judgment: Read and patch ada-moreau as creator@example.com and compare the stored row.

items.criterion: A submission carrying a placeholder is refused with the placeholder fields named.
items.judgment: Save INSERT NAME in the statement and Pill Text in a credit, then submit.

items.criterion: An application mails Confirm your address with the confirmation link on its first line.
items.judgment: Apply with a fresh email and read the delivered message in Mailpit.

items.criterion: Publishing makes a submitted profile live on its division, the roster and the sitemap at once.
items.judgment: Publish a submitted profile as the curator and read every public surface.

items.criterion: No site event is stored after the consent card is answered No thanks.
items.judgment: Decline consent in a fresh browser, browse three routes and count site events.

items.criterion: A write carrying a stale version is refused and stores nothing.
items.judgment: Save twice with the first version and read the stored name.

items.criterion: Repeated failed sign-ins for one email are refused with 429.
items.judgment: Fail five sign-ins for one email and try the right password.
